en.headline: Houthi forces advance toward Aden
en.body: Houthi rebels have advanced toward the interim capital of Aden, according to reports from France 24 and The Straits Times. The movement follows recent military successes by the group against the internationally recognized government.

es.headline: Las fuerzas hutíes avanzan hacia Adén
es.body: Los rebeldes hutíes han avanzado hacia la capital provisional de Adén, según informan France 24 y The Straits Times. El movimiento se produce tras los recientes éxitos militares del grupo contra el gobierno reconocido internacionalmente.

de.headline: Huthi-Kräfte rücken auf Aden vor
de.body: Huthi-Rebellen sind laut Berichten von France 24 und The Straits Times auf die Interims-Hauptstadt Aden vorgerückt. Die Bewegung folgt auf jüngste militärische Erfolge der Gruppe gegen die international anerkannte Regierung.

fr.headline: Les forces houthies progressent vers Aden
fr.body: Les rebelles houthis ont progressé vers la capitale provisoire d'Aden, selon des informations relayées par France 24 et The Straits Times. Ce mouvement fait suite aux récents succès militaires du groupe contre le gouvernement internationalement reconnu.

pt.headline: Forças Houthi avançam em direção a Aden
pt.body: Os rebeldes Houthi avançaram em direção à capital provisória de Aden, segundo relatos da France 24 e do The Straits Times. O movimento segue-se a recentes sucessos militares do grupo contra o governo reconhecido internacionalmente.

ja.headline: フーシ派勢力がアデンへ進軍
ja.body: フランス24およびストレーツ・タイムズの報道によると、フーシ派の反政府勢力が暫定首都アデンに向けて進軍した。この動きは、同勢力が国際的に承認された政府に対して最近収めた軍事的成功に続くものである。

ko.headline: 후티 반군, 아덴 향해 진격
ko.body: 프랑스 24와 스트레이츠 타임스의 보도에 따르면 후티 반군이 임시 수도 아덴을 향해 진격했다. 이번 움직임은 최근 국제적으로 인정받는 정부를 상대로 거둔 군사적 성과에 뒤이어 나타났다.

it.headline: Le forze Houthi avanzano verso Aden
it.body: I ribelli Houthi sono avanzati verso la capitale provvisoria di Aden, secondo quanto riportato da France 24 e The Straits Times. Il movimento segue i recenti successi militari del gruppo contro il governo riconosciuto a livello internazionale.

zh.headline: 胡塞武装向亚丁推进
zh.body: 据法国24和《海峡时报》报道，胡塞叛军已向临时首都亚丁推进。此次行动是在该组织近期在国际公认政府方面取得军事胜利之后发生的。

sources.title: Yemen: Why the Houthis may besiege Aden rather than storm it
Explainer: Untangling Yemen’s complex civil war

en.title: Escalation in Yemen Conflict
en.dek: Military operations intensify across Yemen as coalition airstrikes target Houthi sites and ground combat escalates in Taiz and Aden.

de.title: Eskalation im Jemen-Konflikt
de.dek: Militärische Operationen eskalieren im Jemen: Koalitionsluftschläge treffen Huthi-Stellungen, und der Bodenkampf intensiviert sich in Taiz und Aden.

es.title: Escalada en el conflicto de Yemen
es.dek: Las operaciones militares se intensifican en Yemen, ya que los ataques aéreos de la coalición tienen como objetivo sitios hutíes y la lucha terrestre escala en Taiz y Aden.

fr.title: Escalade du conflit au Yémen
fr.dek: Les opérations militaires s'intensifient dans tout le Yémen, les frappes aériennes de la coalition ciblant des sites Houthis et les combats au sol s'intensifient à Taiz et à Aden.

it.title: Escalatione nel conflitto in Yemen
it.dek: Le operazioni militari si intensificano in Yemen: gli attacchi aerei della coalizione colpiscono obiettivi degli Houthi e lo scontro a terra si intensifica a Taizz e Aden.

zh.title: 也门冲突升级
zh.dek: 军事行动在也门升级，联盟空袭胡塞武装目标，泰兹和亚丁地面战斗加剧。

pt.title: Escalation no Conflito no Iémen
pt.dek: As operações militares intensificam-se no Iémen, ataques aéreos da coalizão visam alvos hutis e o combate terrestre agrava-se em Taize e Aden.

ja.title: イエメン紛争の激化
ja.dek: 連合軍の空爆でフーシ派の標的が攻撃され、タイズとアデンでの地上戦が激化する中、イエメン全域で軍事作戦が激化している。

ko.title: 예멘 분쟁 격화
ko.dek: 예멘 전역에서 군사 작전이 격화되며 연합군 공습이 후티 진지를 타격하고 타이즈와 아덴에서 지상 전투가 강화되고 있다.

en.title: Houthi forces advance toward Aden in Yemen conflict
en.dek: Houthi rebels have advanced toward the interim capital of Aden following recent military successes.
facts: Houthi rebels advanced toward Aden on 18 November 2026
The interim capital Aden is the targeted location of the Houthi advance
Reports cite France 24 and The Straits Times as sources
The advance follows recent military successes by Houthi forces
Houthi forces have targeted the internationally recognized government
The movement represents escalation in the Yemen conflict
body: Houthi rebels have advanced toward the interim capital of Aden, according to reports from France 24 and The Straits Times.
The movement follows recent military successes by the group against the internationally recognized government.
France 24 reported on 18 November 2026 that Houthis may besiege Aden rather than storm it.
The Straits Times published an explainer on Yemen's complex civil war on 18 November 2026.
The advance represents a significant escalation in the ongoing Yemen conflict.
The internationally recognized government faces increased pressure from Houthi military operations.
The situation reflects the complex dynamics of Yemen's civil war as described by multiple sources.
The advance toward Aden comes amid continued fighting between Houthi forces and government troops.
en.context: Yemen has been experiencing ongoing conflict between Houthi rebels and the internationally recognized government, with the interim capital Aden being a key strategic location in the conflict.
